newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-CATT AND REDMAN SELECTED FOR LIONS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CATT AND REDMAN SELECTED FOR LIONS.

text.p: The English pair of Mike Catt and Nigel Redman, both recently summoned from England's tour of Argentina as Lions replacements, have been selected in the side to play against the Gauteng Lions at Ellis Park on Wednesday.

Catt, who scored 21 points in England's 46-20 victory over Argentina in the first test two Saturdays ago, will partner Austin Healey at halfback while Redman will lock the scrum with Irishman Jeremy Davidson.

Both players make their first appearances for the 1997 British Lions, although Catt's will be the more critical as he is a likely candidate for the first test against South Africa in Cape Town on June 21.
England fullback Tim Stimpson impressed for the Lions - both as a kicker and in general play - when the tourists beat Western Province nine days ago.

But Stimpson, regarded then as the probable test fullback for the series, was highly vulnerable when the Lions slipped to their first tour defeat 30-35 against Northern Transvaal in Pretoria at the weekend.

Most pundits regard Scotland's Gregor Townsend and Welshman Robert Howley as the certain Lions halfback pairing for the forthcoming test series. A reliable kicker would then be needed at fullback and the versatile Catt could well get the nod ahead of both Stimpson and Neil Jenkins.
"This is a very important match for Mike Catt but it's also a very important game for a number of players," Lions coach Ian McGeechan said on Monday.
"We're still sorting a few things out and looking at various combinations. Wednesday's match and Saturday's clash with Natal are key games as we prepare for the first test against South Africa."

British Lions team: Nick Beal; John Bentley, Allan Bateman, Will Greenwood, Tony Underwood; Mike Catt, Austin Healey; Tim Rodber, Neil Back, Rob Wainwright, Nigel Redman, Jeremy Davidson, Tom Smith, Barry Williams, Phil Wallace.
Substitutes: Neil Jenkns, Jeremy Guscott, Matt Dawson, Keith Wood, David Young, Eric Miller.
